messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Automated alert — elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 during rollout of model version v2.3.1. Initial detection at 2026-03-15T02:13Z. Affected backend pool: redwood-alpha-canary. Paging on-call.

Dylan Ops: oncall here, acking. jumping in to collect timeline and impact. can we get a short summary of what changed in this rollout?

Carol (ML): rolling v2.3.1 -> quantized q8_128 for latency savings; only went to canary (5% traffic) in eu-west-1. No prompt changes. I’m seeing model perplexity increase in a small eval set but didn't expect 5xx. hypothesis: runtime OOM or kvcache mismatch with quantized kernels.

Ben T.: pulling logs now. attaching a short tail: ```[2026-03-15T02:12:45Z] inference: request_id=abc123 model=v2.3.1 kernel=q8_128 seq_len=512 mem_used=92% ERROR: forward_failed: cuda out of memory
[2026-03-15T02:12:46Z] router: retrying request_id=abc123 fallback=model-v2.2.9 -> 200
[2026-03-15T02:12:46Z] proxy: upstream_5xx_count=18/60s```

Alice M.: thanks Ben. that's consistent with what I'm seeing in the runtime metrics: a spike in GPU mem pressure coincident with the canary. p50 latency didn't move much but p95/p99 climbed and a handful of requests hit 5xx.

Dylan Ops: do we have per-tenant impact? Priya, any customer reports?

Priya CS: got 3 inbound tickets from enterprise customers in EU saying API calls returned 502s and timeouts between 02:12–02:18 UTC. No broad outage but high impact for those customers' processes. Customer A had retries that doubled cost. Logged priority: p1 for those accounts.

Carol (ML): canary config: traffic_percent=5, rollout_id=rl-2026-0315-01. model artifact checksum: sha256:fa12...; quantization script used cpu-side post-training quant with libs v0.9. We may have missed a kernel fallback path for variable kv cache sizes.

Ben T.: sharing a diff of canary vs baseline runtime config: ```--- baseline v2.2.9
+++ canary v2.3.1
- kernel_selection: auto
+ kernel_selection: q8_optimized
- max_kv_mem: 8GB
+ max_kv_mem: 6.5GB
- safety: strict
+ safety: best_effort```

Dylan Ops: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause canary rollout (stop new canary traffic), 2) pin traffic back to v2.2.9 for canary group, 3) increase pool memory limit and let canary continue. What's fastest?

Carol (ML): fastest is pause and pin to v2.2.9. increasing memory requires infra changes and may not be safe for all pods. pausing rollout will stop new canary assignments but won't auto-fix in-flight ones. pin = immediate routing change.

Alice M.: I can execute the pin. command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/api/rollouts/pin \
  -d '{"rollout_id":"rl-2026-0315-01","pin_to":"v2.2.9"}'``` Will run after we confirm.

Ben T.: quick check: before rolling back, confirm no config drift that would make v2.2.9 get same errors. I spot one difference: canary env also had `kernel_selection=q8_optimized` toggled at runtime flag. confirm flags for v2.2.9 are default.

Priya CS: please note customers have requested continuous updates. I'll post a short customer-facing note once we decide mitigation.

Dylan Ops: agree to pin. Alice, go ahead. Take a screenshot of the control-plane response and paste it here. Also run `curl https://router.internal/status?pool=redwood-alpha-canary` after.

Alice M.: running now. ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"pinned","rollout_id":"rl-2026-0315-01","pinned_to":"v2.2.9","timestamp":"2026-03-15T02:16:03Z"}```
router status after pin: ```pool=redwood-alpha-canary active_version=v2.2.9 traffic_percent=0.0 pending_reassign=24```

SRE-Bot: Automated action: rolling back canary assignments to v2.2.9. workload reassign in progress (24 sessions), expected completion ~ 40s.

Ben T.: logs show retries succeeding when hitting v2.2.9. sample: ```[2026-03-15T02:16:22Z] router: request_id=def456 routed_to=v2.2.9 status=200 latency=310ms```

Dylan Ops: great. Priya, craft a 1–2 sentence customer update: acknowledge issue, mitigation done, next steps (RCA + timeline).

Priya CS: posted to affected customers: "We observed transient 5xxs during a canary rollout of a model variant in EU. We have pinned traffic back to the previously stable model and retries are succeeding. Our engineering teams are investigating the root cause and will follow up with an RCA and timeline."

Carol (ML): next actions for RCA: - gather full timeline (deploy start, first 5xx, peak, pin) - collect per-instance CUDA mem stats, kernel selection logs, and a corpus of failing requests to reproduce locally - run the quantized artifact through canary evaluation harness with production-like seq lengths (512+)

Ben T.: I exported the node-level metrics and put them in /artifacts/incidents/2333456789/metrics.tar.gz. also exported a small failing-request set to /artifacts/incidents/2333456789/failing-requests.jsonl.

Dylan Ops: capturing hypothesis in-thread: H1: q8_optimized kernel selection with reduced max_kv_mem causes OOM on long sequences -> 5xx. H2: a scheduling/pathway bug in the new runtime kernels causing memory leakage under burst traffic. We should test H1 first.

Carol (ML): agreed. I'll try to reproduce H1 by running the quantized model against the failing-requests locally with `SEQ_LEN=512` and the same kernel flag. command I'm running: ```python tests/repro.py --model artifacts/v2.3.1.q8 --requests incidents/failing-requests.jsonl --kernel q8_optimized``` Will post results.

Alice M.: logging note: create an incident ticket and add the artifacts link + pin confirmation. I'll update the incident ticket now.

Dylan Ops: after Carol's repro attempt, we'll decide whether to: a) unpin and push a fixed q8 build, b) change default kernel fallback behavior, or c) keep pin and schedule a delayed re-rollout after patches. For now, incident mitigation closed — canary pinned and traffic stable. Moving to RCA coordination.

IncidentBot: Incident status changed -> Mitigated. Severity downgraded. Created incident record #INC-2026-0315-2333456789.

Carol (ML): repro finished: reproduces memory spike and OOM with q8_optimized on seq_len=512 (local env). attaching paste of stderr: ```RuntimeError: forward failed - cuda out of memory at layer 8, kv_cache_alloc() requested 512MB```

Dylan Ops: good reproduction. next immediate fix: update canary pipeline to disable `q8_optimized` flag until we can adjust `max_kv_mem` heuristics or improve kernel behavior. Carol, can you propose a fix timeline?

Carol (ML): short fix: revert kernel_selection for v2.3.1 to `auto` and re-run quantization with smaller kv chunking. estimated turnaround 48–72 hours for a validated patch and canary. Longer term: add canary smoke that simulates worst-case seq_len distribution.

Dylan Ops: noted. I'll add action items to the incident ticket and assign owners (Carol: patch + test, Ben: infra heuristics for max_kv_mem, Alice: rollout gating changes). Priya, please update customers post-RCA.

Priya CS: will do. Closing notes: customers have been informed, no data loss, financial impact under review.

Dylan Ops: closing thread — follow-ups tracked in #postmortems and incident ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
